# Extension Tags

> Part of the [oxidged documentation](index.md).
> See also: [Producer Profiles](profiles.md)

<!-- Generated by `BLESS=1 cargo test --test profiles extension_docs_are_current`: do not edit by hand. -->

When oxidged reads a file, its producer profile keeps the extension tags it knows and that have no standard form as they are; when it writes GEDCOM 7.x, it declares each of them in `HEAD.SCHMA`. No producer publishes URIs for its own tags, so oxidged documents them here, one anchor per producer and tag: the URI is `https://github.com/trois-six/oxidged/blob/main/docs/extensions.md#<profile>-<TAG>`. The anchors are stable: a tag documented once keeps its anchor. Tags with a URI registered elsewhere (the GEDCOM-L addendum's) are declared with that URI and listed here only for reference.

Facts come from the compatibility research (catalogue rows in brackets); every example in it is fictitious.
